entries.title: Job 32:1
segments: And these three men ceased from answering Job, because he [was] righteous in his own eyes.

entries.title: Job 32:2
segments: And burned the anger of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the family of Ram. His wrath burned against Job, because he had justified himself rather than God.

entries.title: Job 32:3
segments: Also his wrath was kindled against his three friends, because they had found no answer and had condemned Job.

entries.title: Job 32:4
segments: And Elihu had waited beside Job with words, because they [were] older than he in days.

entries.title: Job 32:5
segments: When Elihu saw that there [was] no answer in the mouth of these three men, then his wrath was kindled.

entries.title: Job 32:6
segments: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I [am] young, and you [are] very old; therefore I was afraid, and dared not show you my opinion.

entries.title: Job 32:7
segments: I said, Days should speak, and the multitude of years should teach wisdom.

entries.title: Job 32:8
segments: But a spirit [is] in man giving them perception, even the breath of the Almighty.

entries.title: Job 32:9
segments: [It is] not the great that are wise, nor the aged who understand judgment.

entries.title: Job 32:10
segments: Therefore I say, Listen to me. I also will declare my opinion.

entries.title: Job 32:11
segments: Behold, I waited for your words; I listened to your reasons, while you searched out what to say.

entries.title: Job 32:12
segments: Yes, I listened to you, and, behold, not one of you proved Job wrong [nor] answered his words,

entries.title: Job 32:13
segments: that you do not say, We have found out wisdom. God has pushed him down, not man.

entries.title: Job 32:14
segments: And he has not directed his words against me; and I will not answer him with your words.

entries.title: Job 32:15
segments: They are broken; they answer no more; words have left them.

entries.title: Job 32:16
segments: Shall I wait because you do not speak, because they stand still, answering no more?

entries.title: Job 32:17
segments: I also will answer my part; I also will declare my wisdom.

entries.title: Job 32:18
segments: For I am full of words; the spirit within me presses on me.

entries.title: Job 32:19
segments: Behold, my breast [is] as wine which has no vent; it bursts like new wineskins.

entries.title: Job 32:20
segments: I will speak so that I may be refreshed; I will open my lips and answer.

entries.title: Job 32:21
segments: I will not now lift up the face of a man, nor eulogize [any] man,

entries.title: Job 32:22
segments: For I do not know how to eulogize; else after a little my Maker would take me away.
